ceu: ✦ The trine between the Moon and Mars at {H:1820946469000}

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Say no to a commitment that wears you out.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Listen to a friend's idea with real enthusiasm.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Set a clear goal for this week and write it down.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Talk with someone from another generation or another culture.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.
